description: This is a C++ source file implementing a fuzzing test for the quic::QuicFramer component, specifically testing the processing of data packets in the quiche QUIC implementation. It includes functions to generate packet headers, set up the framer, and process randomized packet data to ensure robustness.

classes.name: QuicSelfContainedPacketHeader
classes.description: A specialized QuicPacketHeader with built-in storage for diversification nonce.

classes.name: FuzzingFramerVisitor
classes.description: A custom framer visitor that counts successful header processing and decryption events during fuzzing.

methods.name: ConsumePacketHeaderFormat
methods.description: Generates a packet header format based on the version and a random boolean.

methods.name: ConsumeParsedQuicVersion
methods.description: Randomly selects a QuicVersion from predefined versions for fuzzing.

methods.name: ConsumeQuicPacketHeader
methods.description: Constructs a randomized QuicPacketHeader with appropriate fields for fuzz testing.

methods.name: SetupFramer
methods.description: Initializes a QuicFramer with visitor, encrypters, and decrypters based on version.
